note: Luis Suárez's cheeky nutmeg finish: PSG 1-3 Barcelona, Parc des Princes, 15 April 2015, his 79th-minute goal. Chapter 1 is keyed from 'Luis Suárez' (the pass) through 'David Luiz' and 'through his legs' (the nutmeg) to 'Goal' (the ball in the top corner): keep the pauses at '...' so it plays near real time.

chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Paris, 2015. Barcelona, in bright yellow, lead Paris Saint-Germain. Luis Suárez races clear. David Luiz rushes across... through his legs! Suárez curls it into the top corner. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Luiz stretches and his legs open. Suárez pokes the ball through the gap, and darts round to collect it.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: Then a curling shot past keeper Salvatore Sirigu. His second nutmeg on Luiz that night!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: watch the defender's feet. If their legs open, play the ball through them, then sprint round to meet it!
